description: This file is a shell script used for testing git submodule status and related actions. It contains test functions, setup commands, and assertions for verifying git behaviors involving submodules, conflicts, and nested submodules.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a git repository at the specified location.

methods.name: test_create_repo_with_commit
methods.description: Creates a repository with an initial commit, adds files 'foo' and 'bar', and commits them.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Verifies that a pattern exists in the output.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command is expected to fail.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that a file is empty.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test environment timestamp or state.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Sets global git configuration for testing.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the actual output to an expected output file.
